source_title: Happy Halloween! Which spooky film are you watching tonight? ‘Tumbbad’, ‘Stree’, ‘Bhool Bhulaiyaa’ and more on OTT
source_excerpt: Halloween is the perfect time to dive into stories filled with spooky mysteries, supernatural encounters and spine-chilling twists. And if you're looking to add a desi touch to your Halloween celebrations, Bollywood has plenty of horror and horror-comedy films to keep you entertained. From terrifying supernatural forces to haunted mansions and mysterious creatures, here are five Bollywood films to watch on OTT this Halloween for a thrilling movie night.'Tumbbad' â Amazon Prime VideoSet in a mysterious village in Maharashtra, 'Tumbbad' follows a man's obsession with a hidden treasure guarded by a terrifying supernatural entity. Blending Indian mythology, greed and atmospheric horror, the film delivers a visually stunning yet deeply unsettling experience. Its haunting visuals, haunting storytelling and unforgettable creature make it a must-watch this Halloween for anyone who enjoys dark folklore and psychological horror.'Shaitaan' â NetflixStarring Ajay Devgn, R. Madhavan and Jyotika, Shaitaan revolves around a family whose peaceful getaway turns into a nightmare after a mysterious stranger enters their lives. When their daughter falls under his control, the family faces a terrifying battle against black magic and supernatural forces. Packed with suspense, disturbing moments and powerful performances, this film is a perfect Halloween pick for fans of possession horror.'Stree' â JioHotstarInspired by an urban legend, 'Stree' takes viewers to the town of Chanderi, where a mysterious female spirit appears during an annual festival and abducts men. Starring Rajkummar Rao and Shraddha Kapoor, the film brilliantly combines supernatural horror, small-town folklore and laugh-out-loud comedy. With creepy encounters, unexpected twists and memorable characters, 'Stree' is an entertaining Halloween watch for those who enjoy their horror with a generous dose of humour.'Munjya' â JioHotstarRooted in Maharashtrian folklore, 'Munjya' follows a young man who discovers a terrifying family secret involving a mischievous supernatural creature. What begins as a visit to his ancestral village soon turns into a spooky adventure filled with strange happenings and unexpected scares. Featuring Abhay Verma and Sharvari, the film blends traditional folklore, horror and comedy, making it a fun Halloween choice for viewers who enjoy supernatural stories with a quirky twist.'Bhool Bhulaiyaa' â JioHotstarStarring Akshay Kumar, Vidya Balan and Shiney Ahuja, Bhool Bhulaiyaa revolves around a mysterious mansion where strange paranormal incidents begin to unfold. As a psychiatrist investigates the unsettling events, hidden secrets and psychological mysteries come to light.
